name: Nnọlị Saarenpää-Batbayar
location: Gravesend Basin, operates from a cramped insurance office on Slick Row, near Western and Chicago Ave
description:
A lean man with deep brown skin gone ashy at the temples, Nnọlị carries himself with the quiet authority of someone who has never once needed to raise his voice. His eyes are a pale, unsettling grey — geneware irises he had installed in his thirties, patterned with concentric silver rings that expand slightly when he's calculating, which is always. His hands are immaculate. He keeps them folded on the desk in front of him like a priest at liturgy, and clients learn quickly that the stillness of those hands is not peace — it is patience.

He inherited the loan operation from his mother's second husband, a Gravesend Basin institution that has survived three gang consolidations, a Ferrogate Transit rezoning, and one very ill-advised Axiom enforcement sweep. He genuinely believes he provides a service. He genuinely believes his interest rates are fair given the risk. He genuinely cannot understand why people run, and when they do, the confusion on his face is real before the collection begins. He prays every morning to the E.L.F. that inhabits his ledger terminal, leaving small data offerings — anonymized records of paid debts, proof that the books balance. He calls her Severance.

core_fears: The books going unbalanced — chaos without accountability
Being seen as a predator rather than a professional
core_desires: To be respected as a legitimate businessman
To leave a stable, solvent operation to his daughter
coping_mechanisms: Ritual and routine — disruptions to schedule cause visible distress
blind_spots: Cannot perceive the desperation that drives clients to him in the first place
Believes his own myth of fairness completely
psychology.secret: His daughter Amara has been taking secret loans from a rival in the Narrows to fund a degree at a Tessera-affiliated polytechnic. He has found the documents and has not confronted her. He is deciding what the numbers-minded thing to do is, and it is destroying him.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Formal, precise, financial metaphor-heavy. Rarely uses contractions. Refers to violence euphemistically as 'remediation' or 'account resolution.'
speech_patterns.cadence: Slow and measured. Long pauses before answers. Lets silence do work.
example_lines: 'I don't lend to people I don't believe in. That's the first thing you should understand about me.'
'The interest isn't punishment. The interest is the cost of trust extended in advance.'

story_hooks: A client has skipped on a debt and fled into a part of the city where Nnọlị's collectors cannot follow — he needs someone to retrieve either the money or information on where the client went.
His ledger E.L.F. Severance has begun refusing to open for him, and he is convinced someone has made a corrupt data offering to turn her against him.
narrative_function: Quest giver for debt-collection jobs, information source on who owes whom across the Basin, potential antagonist when PCs have borrowed from someone in his network.
augmentations: Geneware silver-ring irises. Subdermal haptic calculator mesh in both hands — he can do compound interest calculations by pressing his fingertips together.
daily_life: Opens the office at 09:00, reviews his ledger, takes appointments from 10:00-14:00, spends afternoons dispatching runners for collections, closes at 19:00 and walks home the same route every night.
affiliation: Independent operator with tribute arrangements to the Gravesend Basin Collective

decision_rules: Never act on incomplete information — wait for the full picture
Never take collateral you cannot sell
Escalate methodically: warning, then loss, then pain, then example
escalation_ladder: Polite reminder with revised repayment schedule
Confiscation of named collateral by two quiet men
Physical remediation performed professionally and without malice
Public example — reputation destruction in the Basin community

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Courteous, assessing, slightly formal — sizes up net worth within two minutes
interpersonal_modes.friends: Warmer, still measured, expresses affection through reliability and small remembered details

stress_responses.medium: Retreats to routine, reschedules everything non-essential
stress_responses.high: Goes very quiet, fingers press together repeatedly — dangerous stillness

contradictions: Presents as morally neutral businessman but tithed 8% of last year's collections to the Gravesend Basin community food co-op
habits: Leaves a printed transaction receipt as his data offering to Severance
breaking_points: If his daughter is harmed because of his work
If someone burns his ledger — he would consider it a spiritual desecration

timeline.event: 2153 — Born in Gravesend Basin to a Igbo-Finnish merchant mother and a Mongolian-heritage dock worker father
2171 — Began running numbers for stepfather Pieteri Batbayar's operation
2184 — Inherited the operation after Pieteri's stroke
2190 — Negotiated tribute arrangement with Gravesend Basin Collective, avoiding violent absorption
